calculation.description: Ranks the lagged 20-trading-day logarithmic trend by downside semi-deviation estimated over the prior 40 trading days. Positive values favor persistent gains achieved with less downside risk; negative values identify declining assets. Signal is shifted one completed day to prevent lookahead.

validation.regime_notes: Early and middle thirds were positive (IC 0.04844 and 0.04170); late third was negative (IC -0.03420), indicating material regime drift. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation despite long history.

notes: Admission uses 10-day cross-sectional Spearman IC and annualized daily ICIR gates: absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840.
